column1: # Full-phrase dialogue options. zh <TAB> en <TAB> [note]
# NOT a forced-substring file (no 05_-10_ prefix), so these land in proseExact
# and are matched at the EXACT stage - which runs BEFORE the template regexes.
# That ordering is the whole point: the generic pattern
#     ^[和与]\s*(.+?)\s*对话$  ->  "Talk with $1"
# would otherwise fire first and emit "Talk with 结界湖的神秘强者", leaving the
# captured group untranslated for the fragment pass to half-fix into
# "Talk with Barrier Lake的神秘强者".
# The pattern stays useful for options whose middle is just a name
# ("和 枫杏红 对话" -> "Talk with Feng Xinghong"); it must simply not outrank a
# translation of the entire line.
和结界湖的神秘强者对话
column2: Talk with the mysterious powerhouse of Barrier Lake

# --- v9.8: the character 峰 (Feng) inside name-embedding templates ---
# "你应该与 ${dialogue} 对话" and "[和与] ${name} 对话" are whole-node REGEXES,
# and a regex inserts $1 verbatim. 峰 is EXACT-only on purpose - as a
# fragment it would wreck 巅峰 (Peak) and 峰大哥 - so it cannot resolve when
# embedded, and the log read "You should talk to 峰".
# EXACT entries for the rendered forms instead: stage 1 runs BEFORE the
# regex stage, so these win outright and 峰 stays out of the fragment
# alternation entirely. 47 of the 49 dialogue names already resolve as
# fragments; these two are the only ones that cannot.
你应该与 峰 对话
你应该与 峰(飞云) 对话
与 峰 对话
与 峰(飞云) 对话
和 峰 对话
和 峰(飞云) 对话
